description: Source code implementing Qpack header table classes for QUIC protocol, including encoder and decoder header table management, header field lookup, insertion, eviction, and observer notification.

classes.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTable
classes.description: Manages the encoder's header table, including insertion, header field lookup, and eviction logic.

classes.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTable
classes.description: Manages the decoder's header table, including insertion, lookup, and observer notification.

methods.name: InsertEntry
methods.description: Inserts a header entry into the table, updating internal indices and possibly replacing existing entries.

methods.name: FindHeaderField
methods.description: Finds a header field in static or dynamic tables, returning match type and index.

methods.name: MaxInsertSizeWithoutEvictingGivenEntry
methods.description: Calculates maximum size of new entries that can be inserted without evicting a specified entry.

methods.name: draining_index
methods.description: Calculates the index up to which entries can be drained based on a draining fraction.

methods.name: RemoveEntryFromEnd
methods.description: Removes the oldest entry from the dynamic table.

methods.name: LookupEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a header entry by index, considering static or dynamic table.

methods.name: RegisterObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer to be notified when a certain insert count is reached.
